newsitem.title: UK: Comm Union U.S. unit buys York Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Comm Union U.S. unit buys York Insurance.

text.p: British insurer Commercial Union Plc said on Tuesday its U.S. subsidiary Commercial Union Corporation had agreed to acquire York Insurance Company of Maine for 20 million stg.
York, mainly a personal lines writer, had a net book value of 11 million stg as on December 31, 1996.
York's premium income in 1996 was 14 million stg.
"CUC is already the leading insurer in Maine and this acquisition provides a strong platform for further profitable growth in northern New England," Commercial Union said.
The acquisition will be financed from CUC's existing resources.
